title: 第281章 毒士借病呈猛药，只言八字扣宫门
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜寒酒尽，灯晕低垂。

沐远怔在席间，满目疑窦：“先生莫要拿沐远取笑了。贡单如千斤巨石压顶，五部头人现下皆是自顾不暇、焦头烂额。祸事当头，怎就成了‘正当其时’？”

陈醉自盘中拈起一根长鱼刺，在粗木案几上划了一道白痕。

“殿下方才不是自己说了。”陈醉视线从白痕上抬起，

“头人们今日在殿上吵，争的是天狼人的刀子，到底要割谁身上的肉。”

沐远未接话，目光顺着鱼刺看去。

陈醉两指将鱼刺折成两截，丢在桌角：

“无病之人，谁肯尝药？早来十日，五部当陈某是多事的闲商。晚来十日，血都放干了，喝药也迟了。偏偏是今日，人人身上都挨着刀，陈某的袖子里，恰好有药。"

沐远身子前倾了半寸：“难道……大宁边军肯为我室韦出兵，抵挡天狼铁骑？”

问罢，沐远自嘲般地连连摇头：“头人们心里都有一本明账。当年铁骊被围，韩岳手握十万重兵都不肯拔刀相助。周千户即便有平津斩敌之威，可手中兵马再精悍，于大宁朝廷而言，总归只是个千户。区区一营的兵马，又怎会替咱们室韦去同天狼人数万大军硬拼？”

陈醉靠着木椅背，双手交叠于腹前：“五部头人畏惧的，当真只是天狼人的弯刀么？”

沐远一滞，不解其意。

“殿下只需替陈某带八个字，见与不见，凭头人们自己掂量。”

沐远屏住呼吸：“哪八个字？”

陈醉一字一顿：“宁商求见，随车有盐。”

“只此八个字？”沐远道。

“够了。”陈醉端起木碗，将残酒晃了晃，“剩下的话，大宁的青盐自己会替我跟他们说清楚。”

沐远深知盐于室韦意味着什么，这正是各部头人拿捏底层的命脉，也是天狼人套在他们脖颈上的铁锁。

沐远按捺不住急迫，张口便欲追问：“先生这盐，价钱如何？又作何计较能……”

话未出尽，陈醉已抬手拦住了他的话头。

“明日，殿下只管坐在殿上看戏便是。”陈醉仰脖，将碗中残酒饮尽。

“殿下两年前提议立常市，被人笑话。陈某今日把话撂下，从明日起，室韦朝堂上，再没人敢轻视殿下。”

他掸了掸衣襟站起身，又补了半句：

“当然。若陈某明日在殿上办砸了这桩差事。殿下便只当今夜不曾听过这番酒话，陈某也只当从未来过额尔木城。买卖人的规矩，本钱各自担着，绝不连累殿下半分。”

沐远怔怔地望着陈醉。

原本只是随和中带些倨傲的中原儒士，此刻在这破败驿馆的灯火下，身上竟透出深不可测的威势。

沐远缓缓站起身，理平衣衫褶皱，对着陈醉深深一揖。

礼罢，沐远转身向外走去。

行至门槛处，他忽地顿住步子：“札达部头人，莫敦，与天狼人过从甚密。明日殿上，先生留神。”

随即大步迈入沉沉夜色之中。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It's a cold night, the wine is gone, the lamp is dim and drooping.

Mu Yuan was stunned at the table, his eyes full of doubts: "Sir, don't make fun of Mu Yuan. The tribute list is like a huge boulder weighing on the top, and the five leaders are all too busy to take care of themselves and are worried. How can it be 'just the right time' when the disaster is in front of us?"

Chen Zui picked up a long fish bone from the plate and made a white mark on the rough wooden table.

"Your Highness, you didn't say it yourself." Chen Zui looked up from Bai Hen.

"The chiefs were quarreling in the hall today. They were arguing about whose flesh the Sirius man was going to cut with his knife."

Mu Yuan did not answer, but looked along the fishbone.

Chen Zui broke the fish bone into two pieces with two fingers and threw it on the corner of the table:

"Who is willing to try medicine when he is not sick? I came ten days early and thought that Chen was a busy businessman. I came ten days late and the blood had dried up, and it was too late to drink the medicine. But today, everyone has a knife on their body, and Chen happened to have medicine in his sleeve."

Mu Yuan leaned forward half an inch: "Could it be that... the Daning border army is willing to send troops for my Shiwei to resist the Sirius cavalry?"

After asking, Mu Yuan shook his head in a self-deprecating manner: "The leaders have a clear idea in their hearts. When Tie Li was besieged, Han Yue refused to draw his sword to help with a hundred thousand soldiers. Even if Zhou Qianhu has the power to kill the enemy in Pingjin, but no matter how powerful the soldiers and horses are, to the Daning court, they are still only a thousand households. How can a mere battalion of soldiers and horses go to fight for Shiwei against tens of thousands of Sirius troops?"

Chen Zui leaned on the back of the wooden chair and folded his hands in front of his abdomen: "Is it really just the Scimitar of the Sirius that the Wubu heads are afraid of?"

Mu Yuan hesitated for a moment, not understanding what he meant.

"Your Highness only needs to bring eight words for Chen. Whether you see him or not is up to you."

Mu Yuan held his breath: "Which eight characters?"

Chen Zui said word by word: "I'd rather Shang ask for a meeting, and I'll take care of you."

"Just these eight words?" Mu Yuan said.

"That's enough." Chen Zui picked up the wooden bowl and swung the remaining wine, "If there's anything left left, Daning's Qingyan himself will make it clear to them for me."

Mu Yuan knew very well what it meant to be salty in Shiwei. This was the lifeline for the leaders to control the bottom, and it was also the iron chain the Sirius people put on their necks.

Mu Yuan couldn't restrain his impatience and opened his mouth to ask: "Sir, what's the price of this salt? And how can we calculate..."

Before he finished speaking, Chen Zui raised his hand to stop him.

"Tomorrow, Your Highness will just sit in the hall and watch the show." Chen Zui raised his head and drank the remaining wine in the bowl.

"His Highness proposed establishing Chang City two years ago, but was laughed at. Chen put down his words today. From tomorrow on, no one in the imperial court will dare to look down on His Highness."

He dusted his clothes, stood up, and added another sentence:

"Of course. If Chen fails to do this job in the palace tomorrow, His Highness will just pretend that he has never heard these drunken conversations tonight, and Chen will just pretend that he has never been to Ermu City. The rules of businessmen are that everyone should bear the capital, and His Highness will not be harmed in the slightest."

Mu Yuan looked at Chen Zui blankly.

The Central Plains Confucian scholar who was originally just easy-going and somewhat arrogant now actually exudes unfathomable power under the lights of this dilapidated post house.

Mu Yuan stood up slowly, smoothed out the wrinkles in his clothes, and bowed deeply to Chen Zui.

After bowing, Mu Yuan turned around and walked out.

When he reached the threshold, he suddenly stopped and said, "The leader of Zada, Mo Dun, is very close to the Sirius people. I will pay attention to you, sir, in the palace tomorrow."

Then he strode into the dark night.
